dimensions.assessment: Involves NASA, commercial Earth remote sensing vendors, federal researchers, and other federal agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator shall establish within the Earth Science Division... the `Commercial SmallSat Data Acquisition Program'

dimensions.assessment: Formalizes and expands an existing pilot program to provide broad scientific data access.
dimensions.evidence: acquire and disseminate commercial Earth observation data and imagery in order to complement the scientific, operational, and educational requirements

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes program activities and procurement without stating specific funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: procure commercial Earth remote sensing data and imagery from commercial vendors to advance scientific research

dimensions.assessment: Codifies an ongoing program into federal statute and outlines license terms, agency coordination, and annual reporting.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 603 of title 51, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory program with ongoing annual reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this section, and annually thereafter, the Administrator shall submit... a report

missing_information: Specific authorized dollar amounts or budget limits for data purchases
importance_detail.rationale: Gives statutory authority to NASA's Commercial SmallSat Data Acquisition Program to procure commercial Earth observation data and imagery, with reporting requirements.
